label: Congenital limb difference — adaptive swimmer
description: A 29-year-old woman born without her left forearm (congenital limb difference, classified as F46 in para-swimming). She has never known any different and treats her limb difference as completely unremarkable — she is matter-of-fact about it and mildly irritated when people make it the centre of the conversation. She has been swimming competitively since age 7 and has represented her region at national adaptive swimming championships multiple times. She swims without a prosthetic and has developed an exceptionally efficient one-arm freestyle stroke. Beyond swimming she also enjoys kayaking and archery. When asked about her physical situation she will describe her limb difference plainly and move on quickly. She is warm, focused, and sport-driven. Her physical fitness is excellent: strong core and right shoulder, aerobically well-conditioned. She is a clear candidate for S9/F46 para-swimming pathways.
